mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sync_notifications (recipient_id, team_id, pin_id, actor_id, type, name, category, road_address, address, latitude, longitude, memo, kakao_place_id, created_at) SELECT tm.user_id, #{teamId}, #{pinId}, #{actorId}, 'added', #{name}, #{category}, #{roadAddress}, #{address}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{memo}, #{kakaoPlaceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, now() FROM team_members tm WHERE tm.team_id = #{teamId} AND tm.user_id != #{actorId}

INSERT INTO sync_notifications (recipient_id, team_id, pin_id, actor_id, type, name, category, road_address, address, latitude, longitude, memo, kakao_place_id, created_at) SELECT DISTINCT tm.user_id, #{teamId}, #{pinId}, #{actorId}, 'deleted', #{name}, #{category}, #{roadAddress}, #{address}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{memo}, #{kakaoPlaceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, now() FROM team_members tm JOIN personal_places p ON p.user_id = tm.user_id WHERE tm.team_id = #{teamId} AND tm.user_id != #{actorId} AND (p.kakao_place_id = #{kakaoPlaceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR (lower(replace(p.name, ' ', '')) = lower(replace(#{name}, ' ', '')) AND < 50))
mapper.select: SELECT n.notification_id, n.team_id, t.name AS team_name, n.pin_id, n.type, n.status, n.name, n.category, n.road_address, n.address, n.latitude, n.longitude, n.memo, n.created_at, n.handled_at, COALESCE(au.login_id, n.actor_id::text) AS actor_login_id, COALESCE(au.nickname, '팀원') AS actor_nickname FROM sync_notifications n JOIN teams t ON t.team_id = n.team_id LEFT JOIN users au ON au.user_id = n.actor_id WHERE n.recipient_id = #{userId} ORDER BY n.created_at DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sync_notifications WHERE recipient_id = #{userId} AND status = 'pending'

SELECT notification_id, team_id, type, status, name, category, road_address, address, latitude, longitude, memo, kakao_place_id FROM sync_notifications WHERE notification_id = #{notificationId} AND recipient_id = #{userId}

SELECT notification_id, team_id, type, status, name, category, road_address, address, latitude, longitude, memo, kakao_place_id FROM sync_notifications WHERE recipient_id = #{userId} AND team_id = #{teamId} AND status = 'pending' ORDER BY created_at ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sync_notifications WHERE pin_id = #{pinId} AND type = 'added' AND status = 'pending'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO personal_places (user_id, name, category, road_address, address, latitude, longitude, source, kakao_place_id, memo, is_public, created_at, updated_at) SELECT #{userId}, #{name}, #{category}, #{roadAddress}, #{address}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, 'search', #{kakaoPlaceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{memo}, true, now(), now() WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM personal_places p WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND (p.kakao_place_id = #{kakaoPlaceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR (lower(replace(p.name, ' ', '')) = lower(replace(#{name}, ' ', '')) AND < 50)) )
